question: What metal-substitution and functional association does the inspected primary abstract establish for Ag-substituted CODH?

source.title: Substitution of silver for copper in the binuclear Mo/Cu center of carbon monoxide dehydrogenase from Oligotropha carboxidovorans.
source.authors: Wilcoxen J, Snider S, Hille R.
source.inspection: Exact primary abstract in EuropePMC core response; main text and supporting information unacquired.

source_entry_reference.scope: Exact DOI bibliography association only, not transfer of source protein IDs, native Cu oxidation state, geometry or either mechanism proposal to the assayed Ag preparation.

systems.source_reported_intervention: Ag substituted for Cu in the binuclear Mo/Cu center

systems.identity_scope: Source comparator only; no same-study preparation or assay-condition equality is inferred.

source_assessment.supported: The primary abstract reports functional Ag-substituted CODH and an Ag-coupled EPR signal after CO reduction. One query preserves the metal intervention, spectral association and distinct kinetic endpoints.

limitations: Only the primary abstract was inspected. Main article, Methods, figures and supporting information were not acquired.
Ag-substituted and wild-type are source-named preparations. No complete assay sequence, accession-to-specimen match, shared batch or matched conditions are established.
Ag/Cu/Mo stoichiometry, residual Cu, metal-removal and reconstitution methods, apo controls, Ag occupancy and active metal fraction are unassessed.

The Ag-coupled EPR population and bulk kinetic population are not established as identical. Retained activity is author-attributed to the Ag-substituted enzyme, not proven exclusively to Ag sites by this inspection.
The observed limiting CO-reduction constants are distinct from steady-state kcat and KM. No ratio, 8.1-versus-8.2 rate-limitation inference, intrinsic metal comparison or statistical claim is made.
The wild-type 51 s^-1 is an abstract comparator; its primary experimental provenance, conditions and normalization have not been checked.

pH 7.2 applies only to the steady-state kcat/KM sentence. CO-reduction pH and temperature, all assay buffers, electron acceptor, concentration ranges, protein/active-site normalization and replicate/error data are not reported in the inspected abstract.
The KM analyte is contextually associated with CO but not explicitly restated in the abstract sentence; no fully qualified CO binding or saturation constant follows.

Ag incorporation does not assign Ag oxidation state, coordinate geometry or electron-transfer pathway. No direct CO2-quantitation, physiological quinone/O2 turnover, growth or project experiment is established.

The M0107 citation connects the study to aerobic CODH context only. Neither Cu-specific source proposal is validated, replaced or assigned to the Ag preparation; no protected protein/mechanism admission or evidence-tier promotion.
stopping_condition: The source-reported association is retained at abstract scope. Full-text metal/loading and matched assay controls remain unassessed; no further access campaign or quantitative comparison is justified in this run.
